content.value: Crank's Dungeons replaces several vanilla progression shortcuts so they cooperate with runes, quality, and enchantment slots. This page collects the changes that are easy to mistake for vanilla behavior.

The Smithing Table is the Quality Station. All smithing recipes, smithing-template copying recipes, and armor-trim recipes are removed. Netherite upgrading and armor trims therefore do not use the vanilla smithing workflow.
Anvil operations have zero level cost and their output can be taken without the vanilla level requirement. Enchantment filtering and slot limits still apply; an invalid over-cap result is blocked. Combining matching items inherits the higher available slot count up to that item's cap.
Enchanted books are always limited to one stored enchantment.

Only enchantments approved by the mod's enchanting-table or random-loot tags survive filtering. Vanilla enchanted-equipment trades are removed from equipment villagers, and vanilla Librarian enchanted-book offers are replaced with mod-tier book offers. Librarians add Standard books at novice and apprentice, Greater books at journeyman and expert, and Perfect books at master.

The vanilla armor bar is hidden because Armor uses the custom rating formula. Armor Toughness is not part of this mod's defense model.
Vanilla saturation and natural food healing are removed. Hunger instead controls Well Fed and Starving, as explained in Food & Effects.
Vanilla fire, poison, wither, regeneration, resistance, absorption, instant health, and instant damage behavior is intercepted or translated into the custom damage, ailment, and recovery systems.
Vanilla falling critical attacks are disabled; use the custom Critical Strike Chance and Multiplier.
A raised shield uses the custom directional fixed-block calculation.

A grindstone refuses damageable equipment that already has more than half of its durability missing. A successful grind then adds damage equal to half of maximum durability, stopping one point before destruction.
Press G to toggle supported enchantments such as Silk Touch and Vein Mining. Sneaking while breaking also suppresses their drop-changing behavior for that break.
Vein Mining can break up to 31 additional connected matching ores. Precision Mining and Repair Chance can prevent a durability-loss event.

Do not assume a vanilla guide applies to smithing, enchanting, hunger healing, armor, critical hits, shields, or potion effects in this mod. Use the matching Compendium page for the authoritative custom rule.
